title: chenopodium ambrosioides f. spathulatum
intro: Chenopodium ambrosioides f. spathulatum, commonly known as Mexican tea or epazote, is a plant species belonging to the Amaranthaceae family. This plant has been used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as aiding digestion and relieving nausea, particularly during pregnancy. The therapeutic actions of Mexican tea include its ability to act as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antispasmodic, making it useful for treating various conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for these properties include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which provide its medicinal value.
